items.title: Dorothy Tait Interview, 1968-12-21
items.q: And Jaffe said, you go first.

ctx.x: Right. And Jaffe said, you go first. And behind me stood Lewis and George Lewis and Nelson and the rest of the band. So I knocked on the door of the Swing. The door opened and little Sayori Yamamoto appears. And she looked at me and again, in very hesitant English, said, do you have the autograph? I said, no, but I have George Lewis. And the door opened and George Lewis came in. The place suddenly you could hear just a collective gasp. Everything stopped. And the musicians ended. And within ten seconds there…
Did you hear the George Lewis band playing in Japan? All the time. I traveled with them.
